  "issues": [
    "The error format is described as RFC 9457-style, but the schema uses custom fields (`code`, `message`, `details`) and serves them as `application/json`, not `application/problem+json` nor the standard RFC 9457 fields (`type`, `title`, `status`, `detail`, `instance`). Clients expecting RFC 9457 interop will need a custom adapter.",
    "The data envelope's stated extensibility is contradicted by `additionalProperties: false` on both `TaskList` and `TaskEnvelope`. Adding future top-level metadata (e.g., pagination, request IDs) requires a breaking schema change, defeating the purpose of the envelope.",
    "The list endpoint has no pagination, filtering, or sorting. The proposal acknowledges this as a tradeoff, but it remains a real scalability risk: as task counts grow, the API will likely need breaking changes to add these capabilities.",
    "The `description` field allows an empty string while `title` requires `minLength: 1`. This inconsistent validation of empty strings may confuse clients; if `description` is meant to be optional but non-empty when present, it should also enforce `minLength`."
  ],
